note: A guard: when life is low, the character takes much less damage from hits for a few seconds (the absorb limit is folded into a flat reduction), then waits for the cooldown.

def.name: Iron Hide
def.description: A guard: for a few seconds you take much less damage from hits.

note: A guard: for three seconds it adds armour and takes 75% of the damage from hits into a pool as big as a fifth of the armour (at most 10000); when the buff ends or the pool is spent, the damage it took goes out as fire to the enemies around, many times over.

def.name: Slag Carapace
def.description: A guard of slag: it takes most of the damage into a shell, and gives it back as fire.

note: A guard cast when life is low: for a second the character takes much less damage, longer and with much less physical damage for each Grit charge it spends (up to five). It waits three seconds, and other guards wait with it.

def.name: Deathless Call
def.description: A guard: a call that keeps you standing for a moment, and for longer, with much less physical damage, for each Grit charge you spend.

note: A buff kept up while enemies are near: faster attacks and life leech; it costs 4% of the maximum life (and energy shield) a second as physical damage over time, a kill renews it and may give a Fervour charge. The character lets it go when life runs low.

def.name: Surge of Blood
def.description: Your blood runs hot: faster attacks that leech life, at a cost in life each second.

note: A buff that needs five rage to start, lasts as long as the rage does (it spends five a second, a fifth more every second), and while it lasts gives more attack damage, attack speed and movement speed and less damage taken. Its cooldown does not run while it lasts.

def.name: Rampage Call
def.description: A fury fed by rage: you hit harder and faster, move faster and take less, until the rage is spent.

note: A blink: the character jumps toward a target that is out of reach (cooldown 2 seconds).

def.name: Quick Step
def.description: A short jump toward your target.

note: A blink toward the target: the enemies where it lands are burned, and the ground it crossed burns for four seconds. Three uses are stored, and it shares its cooldown with the other blink skills.

def.name: Cinder Step
def.description: Vanish in a flash of fire, burning the ground behind you and the enemies where you land.

note: A blink toward the target: the enemies where it left are hurt and the ground there is chilled for three seconds. Its cooldown recovers faster for each enemy near the character, a little for a normal one and a lot for a rare one; it shares the cooldown of the other blink skills.

def.name: Rime Step
def.description: Step through the frost: the cold bursts where you left and chills the ground there.

note: A warp toward the target that takes as long as the run would have, a little less; lightning bursts around the place left and around the place reached. The character can act while it waits.

def.name: Bolt Step
def.description: Become lightning and arrive next to your target after the time the run would take.

note: Destroys the character's body and recreates it at an enemy or, in preference, a corpse with enemies about it: it is not a swap (the target does not move). Fire damage bursts at the place left and the place reached, with a share of the character's life added; at a corpse the bursts are much larger and the corpse bursts for a share (6%) of the life it had.

def.name: Shadow Swap
def.description: Go to a corpse or an enemy in a burst of fire at both ends.

note: A burst of speed for 1.8 seconds, with more melee damage, through enemies (they do not push the character) and half as far seen; the first skill used ends the speed, and the damage stays a moment longer. Each Frenzy charge spent doubles the time.

def.name: Slipstream Run
def.description: A burst of speed that makes your melee blows hit harder; the first skill you use ends the speed.

note: A blink toward the target that grants Elusive (renewed in full) and withers the enemies that come near: the first time each does, four stacks at the first level and six at the last, for three seconds. Using any skill ends it. Its cooldown does not run while the buff lasts; it shares the cooldown of the other blink skills.

def.name: Rotting Stride
def.description: A stride that leaves you elusive and withers the enemies that close in, until you do something else.

note: A leap to the target that lands in a slam; stuns enemies on full life.

def.name: Skyfall Leap
def.description: Leap to a target and slam down on it.

note: A charge behind the shield, toward the target: the damage comes from the shield (and its armour and evasion), not the weapon, and grows with how far the charge ran.

def.name: Bulwark Rush
def.description: Charge behind your shield: its weight is the damage, and the longer the run the harder the blow.

note: A whirling dash through the target, hitting once along the way.

def.name: Spinning Dash
def.description: Spin through your target with your weapon out.

note: A channelled spin around the character: it cannot be stunned while it spins; each use builds a stage (more area), and the first hit deals half.

def.name: Twister Blade
def.description: A spin that sweeps everything near, wider the longer it lasts, and cannot be broken by a stun.

note: A strike that carries the character to the target. It waits two seconds between uses, unless a Fervour charge is spent; it gains Fervour charges on hit, attacks faster for each, and speeds the character for three seconds after each use.

def.name: Blinking Cut
def.description: Vanish and strike. It waits two seconds between uses, unless you spend a Fervour charge; each charge quickens it, and each use speeds you for three seconds.

note: Channelled: an illusion runs ahead toward the target (faster than you), with a wave of lightning along its path for every two stages built, harder once it has stopped. Let go, and you join it, with a last wave that deals three quarters of the damage for each stage.

def.name: Storm Rush
def.description: Send an illusion rushing ahead in a trail of lightning, then join it.

note: A slam that carries the character to the target; it is half fire and leaves consecrated ground for four seconds: the character regenerates life on it and hits against enemies on it crit twice as often.

def.name: Blessed Trail
def.description: Run to the target and slam, leaving consecrated ground where you land.

note: A hook thrown at a distant enemy pulls the character to it and strikes an area; a hit gives a point of rage, and the area grows with the rage held.

def.name: Snag Lash
def.description: A hook that pulls you to an enemy and strikes around it; every hit feeds your rage, and rage widens it.
